findings.observed: The shipped command schema and validator expose six operations. Both set_motion_overlay and motion_overlay nested inside set_clip are rejected as invalid_arguments by actual isolated HTTP tool dispatch.
findings.task_blocked: Selected chat model cannot propose adding/removing or moving/retiming a typography overlay through its supported edit tool.
findings.minimal_fix: Extend the existing propose_timeline_changes typed commands with a bounded set/clear overlay command; resolve canonical same-project approved source via existing editing.resolve_motion_overlay; keep proposal/human review/final-output approval separate. No new generic tool/API needed.

findings.observed: Actual search_project_context tool result omits motion_overlay from stored clip occurrences. The raw stored timeline has its source version/start/end/offset. Only the motion head is exposed; older approved source versions are not catalogued.
findings.task_blocked: The model cannot accurately describe or preserve user intent when asked to edit an existing overlay or select a previously approved composition. A shorter otherwise-supported clip edit can be blocked by a hidden overlay interval.
findings.minimal_fix: Add path-free overlay reference/placement to execution_targets.timeline.clips and an approved immutable source metadata projection (version, scene hash, duration, source shot); distinguish reusable source data from current standalone render grant and bound disclosed context.

findings.confidence: High for current code; extension risk not yet a product action
findings.observed: Current timeline_diff covers take/trim/duration/order/captions/audio, with no overlay fields; SYSTEM has no source/start/end/offset/alpha semantics. Manifest binds the approved definitions, but a future extension under an existing tool name needs an explicit old-manifest/new-command rejection check.
findings.task_blocked: Simply adding a command would leave human-visible before/after and model guidance incomplete, and could blur consent scope.
findings.minimal_fix: Include server-computed before/after overlay differences and current-context/immutable-source guidance; test old approved schema manifests cannot silently gain the new command. This is a required validation for the proposed extension, not a claim that current code executes an unauthorized new operation.
